evidence.fact: White Rose adopted statutes and bestowed decorations; the May statute date is not its January establishment date.
evidence.locator: PDF p.6 / printed p.4 and PDF p.38 / printed p.36
evidence.summary: Preface says statutes were adopted 16 May 1919; history says the order was established in January 1919 and statutes ratified 16 May 1919.

evidence.fact: White Rose grades and medal forms.
evidence.summary: Lists Grand Cross, Commander First Class, Commander, Knight First Class, Knight, Cross of Merit, and three medal classes; collar, diamonds, clasps and swords are special attributes/forms rather than separate orders.
Lists Grand Cross, Commander First Class, Commander, Pro Finlandia Medal, Knight First Class, Knight and Cross of Merit; wartime swords are a decoration attribute.

evidence.fact: Cross of Liberty system and standing order dates.
evidence.summary: Senate established the Crosses and Medals of Liberty on 4 March 1918; the permanent Order of the Cross of Liberty was founded by decree on 16 December 1940.
